HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Bapt.]
Nausea, with inclination to vomit, relieved for a short time by eructations.
Feels as if she wants to raise a great deal.
Pressure at stomach, belching of large quantities of wind.
Nausea with eructations, followed by painful vomiting.
Feeling as if he would vomit, but no nausea, with severe shooting in left kidney and to left of umbilicus.
Retching and vomiting. θ Typhoid fever.
Feeling as if it would be a relief to vomit.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Bapt.]
At night frequent pain in epigastric region ; < from turning over, which he had to do all the time.
Full feeling in stomach.
Heavy gnawing in stomach ; 3d day.
Burning heat in stomach rising up towards throat ; 2d day.
Sinking, "gone" feeling at stomach, fainting ; tongue brown in morning. θ Dyspepsia after typhus.
Constant burning distress in epigastrium, severe colicky pains in umbilical, and especially hypogastric region ; rumbling in bowels ; desire to vomit, but without nausea.
Cramp in stomach ; evening.
Severe pain every few minutes in cardiac region of stomach.
Sinking feeling in stomach, with shoulder pains.
Sinking sensation in stomach. θ Typhus.
Pains in stomach ; feeling there as of a hard substance.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Bapt.]
Sensation of weight and oppression in precordial region, with a feeling of unsatisfied breathing ; afternoon.
Dull pain at pit of stomach, with constriction of diaphragm.
Constant pain in stomach and liver ; < walking ; hot sensation ; heavy aching in stomach and liver.
Pain in region of liver on going up-stairs.
Pain in liver, from right lateral ligament to gall-bladder ; can scarcely walk, it so augments pain in gall-bladder.
Must stir about, yet motion is painful ; pain over gall-bladder.
Constant aching distress in stomach and umbilical region, with a great deal of pain in region of gall-bladder ; pain extends to spine.
Pain in region of spleen, with darts of pain in body, especially in carpus, metacarpus and phalanges ; 2d day.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Bapt.]
Severe colicky pains in umbilical and hypochondriac regions, recurring every few seconds ; rumbling desire for stool.
Pain in abdomen with diarrhœa. θ Typhus.
Griping pain in bowels while at stool.
Distress, dull pain in umbilical region.
Distended abdomen ; fulness ; flatulence, rumbling, feels as if vomiting would relieve ; mushy stools.
Sharp, shooting pains in bowels, with constant pain in hypochondriac region.
Dull aching, distress in bowels.
Right iliac region sensitive. θ Typhus.
Abdominal muscles sore on pressure, with acute intermitting pain. θ Typhus.
Abdominal tenderness, with flatulency ; 10th day. θ Typhus.
Cutting in bowels, relieved for a short time by passage of flatus, which causes burning at anus.
Pain in abdomen on pressure, with dull aching in lumbar region on going to bed.
Sharp rheumatic stitches in right groin, lasting but a little while, but after a short interval returning as before.
Severe pain in left groin ; < from walking, > from rest, but returning again on motion.
Glands of left groin swollen ; painful on walking.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Bapt.]
Diarrhœa, with pain and soreness in bowels. θ Typhus.
Soft, papescent stool, with large quantities of mucus.
Stools of pure blood, or bloody mucus.
Fetid, exhausting diarrhœa, causing excoriation.
Thin, watery, offensive diarrhœa day and night ; child can swallow nothing but milk ; smallest quantity of solid food gags.
Aphthous diarrhœa.
Involuntary diarrhœa ; 9th to 11th day. θ Typhus.
Evacuation light yellow or brown, thin and watery. θ Typhus.
Stools soft, papescent, with large quantities of mucus.
Dark brown mucous and bloody stools, with typhoid tendency ; brown tongue, etc.
Stools : dark, thin, fecal, offensive.
Fetid stools. θ Typhus.
Dysentery : rigors, pains in limbs and small of back ; stools small, all blood, not very dark, but thick ; great tenesmus ; great prostration, brown tongue, low fever ; in the Autumn, or in hot weather.
Colicky pains before stool. θ Dysentery in old people.
Stool very small and difficult to pass, it resembles sheep dung ; pain in bowels after stool ; 2d day.
Constipation ; stool very small, passed only by very great straining and urging ; 3d day.
Stool like sheep dung, dry and crumbling ; pain before stool, weakness after stool.
Constipation and diarrhœa ; stools dark and bloodstreaked. θ Diphtheria.
Before stool : severe colic, more in hypogastrium.
During stool : tenesmus ; colic.
After stool : tenesmus ; relief of colic.
Constipation ; hemorrhoids in afternoon.
Stricture from piles.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Bapt.]
Stitches in region of right kidney.
Shooting pains in region of left kidney.
Urine scanty, dark red ; light green.
Burning when urinating.
Urine very highly colored and scanty. θ Typhus.
Urine alkaline, fetid. θ Typhus.
Passes water often with a great deal of fiery pain, water is clear, scum on it in variegated colors ; red sand is passed with urine, and is seen at once on bottom of vessel.
Increased secretion of urine at night.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Bapt.]
Dull drawing in right groin and testicle, also in legs and knee joints.
Orchitis ; cannot sleep because he feels as if his body was scattered about bed.
Pressing pain in left testicle, as if it had been squeezed, lasting but a short time.
Cramps in testes, as if they had been squeezed.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Bapt.]
Menses too early and too profuse.
